verdict.rationale: Composio's documented model is the reverse: it hosts MCP servers/toolkits and exposes them to agents (sessions with mcp:true, composio.mcp.create, Composio Connect at connect.composio.dev/mcp), and its CLI gives local agents a tool surface to reach Composio's cloud. There is no evidence of a feature to take a developer's own locally-running MCP server and bridge/proxy it into Composio as a managed remote connection without deployment.
